lines.speaker: A
lines.hanzi: 考试快到了，你准备好了吗？
lines.pinyin: Kǎoshì kuài dào le, nǐ zhǔnbèi hǎo le ma?
lines.english: The exam is coming soon, are you ready?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 还没准备好。这几天在复习。
lines.pinyin: Hái méi zhǔnbèi hǎo. Zhè jǐ tiān zài fùxí.
lines.english: Not ready yet. These days I'm reviewing.

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 语法、词语、听力，都要复习。
lines.pinyin: Yǔfǎ, cíyǔ, tīnglì, dōu yào fùxí.
lines.english: Grammar, words, listening - all need review.

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 听力最难。说得太快，听不懂。
lines.pinyin: Tīnglì zuì nán. Shuō de tài kuài, tīng bu dǒng.
lines.english: Listening is the hardest. People speak too fast, I can't understand.

lines.speaker: A
lines.hanzi: 多听，多练习吧。我可以帮你。
lines.pinyin: Duō tīng, duō liànxí ba. Wǒ kěyǐ bāng nǐ.
lines.english: Listen more, practice more. I can help you.

lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Hǎo! Xiāngxìn wǒmen dōu néng kǎo hǎo.
lines.english: Good! Believe we can both do well on the exam.
